meta.methodology: Trend-following long only (EMA9 > EMA21 > EMA50) with TP/SL barriers

label_analysis.description: Triple barrier label distribution shows 60% SL even in +39% bull month
label_analysis.root_cause: SL at 1.0x ATR is too tight — normal pullbacks hit it. Even in strong uptrend, 60% of bars have SL hit before TP.
label_analysis.feature_label_correlation: No feature correlates > 0.03 with labels — core problem for ML edge

edge_hypotheses.name: Asymmetric TP/SL by trend
edge_hypotheses.description: Standard 1.5/1.0 vs Wide 2.5/0.7 vs Wide 2.0/0.8 in aligned trends
edge_hypotheses.verdict: Standard 1.5/1.0 is best. Higher TP reduces WR faster than it increases payoff.

edge_hypotheses.name: Pullback entry (RSI filter)
edge_hypotheses.description: Enter long only when RSI < threshold during uptrend
edge_hypotheses.verdict: NOT an edge. Too few trades when filtering, and WR drops. Pullbacks in 15m are noise, not signals.

edge_hypotheses.name: Volume confirmation
edge_hypotheses.description: Enter only when volume > Nx average
edge_hypotheses.verdict: EDGE confirmed. EV increases +20% with vol>1.5x filter. WR stable. Institutional participation signal.

edge_hypotheses.name: Time-of-day filter
edge_hypotheses.description: WR varies by hour — best during US/EU overlap
edge_hypotheses.verdict: WEAK EDGE. 9h UTC (US pre-market) has 39% WR vs 26% average. +13pts is significant but small sample per hour.

edge_hypotheses.name: Cooldown after loss
edge_hypotheses.description: Wait N bars after a losing trade before re-entering
edge_hypotheses.verdict: MAJOR EDGE. Trend continuation after TP is a strong signal (58% WR at cooldown=0). Likely momentum effect. Needs out-of-sample validation to rule out overfitting.
edge_hypotheses.caution: PnL of $462K on $10K capital is unrealistic — does not account for position sizing, fees, slippage, or compounding. The EV/trade signal is real but magnitude is inflated.

recommended_edge_stack.description: Combine actionable edges for production pipeline

filters.name: Trend continuation
filters.rule: After TP hit, re-enter immediately in same direction

filters.name: TP/SL
filters.rule: TP = 1.5x ATR, SL = 1.0x ATR (standard, not wide)

recommended_edge_stack.expected_improvement: WR from 30% to ~40-45%, EV from $5 to $15-20/trade

feature_importance_train_2022h2.note: Volatility (atr_ratio) and trend (close_vs_ema50, momentum) dominate. Volume and returns secondary.
